description:
List all cluster summaries for a document's knowledge graph.

Returns each summary with its highlight_ids array — the highlights that were
in the cluster when the summary was last generated.

DETECTING STALE SUMMARIES:
To check if summaries need updating after adding new links:
1. Call highlyt_list_highlight_links to get all current links
2. Compute connected components (group highlights by connectivity)
3. Call this tool to get stored summaries
4. For each summary, check if its highlight_ids is a SUBSET of a current component
   - If highlight_ids == component_ids → summary is current
   - If highlight_ids ⊂ component_ids → summary is STALE (cluster grew)
   - Set difference (component_ids - highlight_ids) = newly added highlights
5. Regenerate stale summaries with highlyt_upsert_cluster_summary,
   passing the FULL current component highlight_ids
name: highlyt_list_cluster_summaries
title: List Cluster Summaries
